A princess wrote a secret letter to God, the night before her forced wedding. Stay till the end, because His reply was not a letter.

As the story goes, Princess Rukmini had loved Krishna since she first heard His name. But her brother arranged her wedding to Shishupala, a cruel king. So she wrote a secret letter. If you don't come for me, I will give up my life.

She gave it to a trusted brahmin, who ran all the way to Dwarka. But the wedding day came, and there was no sign of Krishna. Rukmini walked to the temple of Goddess Ambika, with tears in her eyes. Wait, was she too late?
As she stepped out of the temple, a golden chariot thundered in. Krishna reached out His hand, and she took it.
That's why girls pray to Krishna and Rukmini for the right life partner. God always answers a true heart. Comment Rukmini, and send this to someone still waiting for their person.
